title: 移动边缘计算中基于LLM辅助合同网协商的多智能体调度
summary: 提出MAS-DecStream，扩展合同网协议为LLM-MR-CNP，通过语义CFP、多轮提案修订和协商记忆，实现流处理任务的去中心化调度。实验显示延迟违规降至3%，冲突解决率0.91，效用提升22%。
summary_en: Proposes MAS-DecStream, extending the Contract Net Protocol with LLM-MR-CNP for decentralized stream processing scheduling. Experiments show latency violations reduced to 3%, conflict resolution rate 0.91, and utility improved by 22%.
